# CitedBy

> CitedBy checks what AI assistants answer when a buyer asks about an online shop's category, then fixes what keeps the shop out of the answer. Service for EU online shops, run from Spain. Free mini-audit; Fix Pack €390 paid once; CitedBy Monthly €149 per month.

## Pages
- [Home, prices and guarantees](https://citedby.eu/): what we do, prices, FAQ
- [Free check](https://citedby.eu/check): paste a shop URL and see in about 10 seconds which AI crawlers the site lets in and what a plain page fetch finds, with a fix for each problem; no email needed. From there you can ask for the free 16-answer mini-audit by email (also /fr/check, /nl/check)
- [AI visibility audit guide](https://citedby.eu/ai-visibility-audit): what a GEO/AEO audit checks for an online shop and how to run a basic one yourself
- [Sample audit](https://citedby.eu/sample-audit): an anonymised mini-audit of a Belgian coffee roaster, run 15 Oct 2026 through the Claude API with web search: the sites linked in each of 16 answers, whether the shop is named, and the fixes
- [Data by niche](https://citedby.eu/data): who ChatGPT linked, question by question, with method and CSV
